full_script: Do not listen to the financial advice of unaccomplished men. One of my mentors bought a wristwatch for forty-three million naira. A spectator asked him: 'Sir, does that watch tell you different time from a wall clock?' He smiled and replied: 'I did not buy this watch to tell the time. I bought it to dictate the time of whoever sits across my desk.' Overthinkers do not have enough time to take action, and overdoers do not have enough time to think. Analysis without capital is just an academic funeral. Know your worth, position your leverage, and remember that perception is ninety percent of market reality.
